subject: Yale Study Shows Prescription Drugs And Diet Shifts Alter Epigenetic Clocks
script: From Agewell Brief: Yale Study Shows Prescription Drugs And Diet Shifts Alter Epigenetic Clocks. An analysis of fifty-one studies shows that prescription drugs and lifestyle changes reliably alter epigenetic blood markers, while popular over-the-counter supplements miss the mark. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
